doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

title: Coconut Island and the Coconut Grove theme song
summary: Billie explains how Coconut Island became her theme song at the Coconut Grove.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Yeah, we were looking over that list of tunes there on the ledger. We're going to have to copy that someday. Yeah, yeah, copy that. Yeah, and we mentioned Coconut Island. Yeah, oh yeah. On a Coconut Island. It was good. Tell us about that, Billy, when you used to play it.

Well, when I played that Coconut Island, that was when I was working with the pig pig, but they named me the Coconut Grove. So why they named me the Coconut Grove, that's why I played that Coconut Island. I changed that theme song, see, to the Coconut Grove, see.
Oh, I got it. A lot of them worked out fine. Now, back again to Pensacola. Back to Pensacola? Again, let's see now. It's all right.
I'm going to buy that Atmore. Oh, Atmore, yeah. Oh.
